tag:ec2.source: Although EC2 allows for any character in its tags, other AWS services are more restrictive.
tag:ec2.noInvalid: EC2 는 태그 값에 어떤 문자든 받는다 — 문자로 거부할 예가 원문에 없다

[a-z](?:[-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?.source: The name must be 1-63 characters long, and comply with RFC1035. Specifically, the name must be 1-63 characters long and match the regular expression [a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])? which means the first character must be a lowercase letter, and all following characters must be a dash, lowercase letter, or digit, except the last character, which cannot be a dash.
